import pytest
import solution
from solution import perimeter


def test_issue_positional_example():
    """assert perimeter(2,4) == 12."""
    assert perimeter(2, 4) == 12  # expected 12 per issue: perimeter(2,4)==12


def test_issue_keyword_example():
    """perimeter(diameter=2, height=4) == 12."""
    assert perimeter(diameter=2, height=4) == 12  # expected 12 per issue: perimeter(2,4)==12


def test_issue_reversed_keywords():
    """perimeter(height=4, diameter=2) == 12."""
    assert perimeter(height=4, diameter=2) == 12  # expected 12 per issue: perimeter(2,4)==12


def test_issue_mixed_args():
    """perimeter(2, height=4) == 12 with mixed args."""
    assert perimeter(2, height=4) == 12  # expected 12 per issue: perimeter(2,4)==12


def test_issue_repeatable():
    """assert perimeter(2,4) == 12 on repeated calls."""
    assert perimeter(2, 4) == perimeter(2, 4) == 12  # expected 12 per issue: perimeter(2,4)==12


def test_contract_function_exists():
    """Public interface defines def perimeter(diameter, height)."""
    assert hasattr(solution, "perimeter")


def test_contract_function_callable():
    """Public interface defines def perimeter(diameter, height) as callable."""
    assert callable(perimeter)


def test_contract_requires_two_args():
    """Public interface def perimeter(diameter, height) requires two arguments."""
    with pytest.raises(TypeError):
        perimeter()


def test_contract_requires_height_arg():
    """Public interface def perimeter(diameter, height) requires height."""
    with pytest.raises(TypeError):
        perimeter(2)


def test_contract_rejects_extra_arg():
    """Public interface def perimeter(diameter, height) takes exactly two arguments."""
    with pytest.raises(TypeError):
        perimeter(2, 4, 5)
